summary: Florida Venetia tower (Sarasota County, built 1956) dismantled in 2019 and re-erected at the Catskill Interpretive Center in Mount Tremper, NY; opening date unconfirmed.

facts.design: Observation tower with 106 steps (Florida newspapers, 1969 and 1988)
facts.status_note: Re-erected at the Catskill Interpretive Center in Mount Tremper in 2019; not confirmed as open to the public

access.note: In August 2019 the tower was not open; a fence was to be put up, with climbing only when paid staff were present. Current access not confirmed.

events.note: Constructed in 1956 at Venetia, Sarasota County, Florida (1969 Tampa Tribune article, transcribed by Forest Lookouts)

Division of Forestry said the tower would lose its full-time spotter in November; in 1975 a Division spokesman said it would not close, and the district forester credited federal jobs-program money with restoring full staffing
A state forest ranger was still climbing the tower to watch for fires, per a 1988 Tampa Tribune article
Tower dismantled for removal in March 2019; parts shipped to New York
Re-erected at the Catskill Interpretive Center in Mount Tremper by Davana LLC; top section lifted by crane. Not open to the public as of the August 2019 newsletter.

notes_for_editor: Opening date: the record's 3 October 2019 opening is not found in any source read. The August 2019 newsletter says the tower would not open until the NYSDEC put up a fence. Search snippets from catskillcenter.org and catskillsvisitorcenter.org (not read; the visitor-center page returned HTTP 403) mention a fall 2019 opening, a fire-tower steward schedule and a short trail, but these are unverified and not cited. Check them before adding current access or visit details. Height: Florida articles give 85 feet (about 26 m) for the original; OSM gives 24 m for the re-erected tower. Unresolved, so height_m 24 comes from OSM only and is flagged. Build year 1956 rests on one 1969 newspaper item. Location disagrees: the 1969 article puts the tower on US 41 between Venice and the Englewood road, the 1974 notice on State Road 775 about four miles south of Venice; the story gives both. The 1974-1975 staffing items are contested in tone (a cut announced, then reversed). Reads used: 6 (eastern Venetia page, NY lookout list grep, April 2019 newsletter, August 2019 newsletter, OSM node, catskillsvisitorcenter.org 403); one WebSearch.
